description: Record the outcome of an execution that was permitted by a prior evaluate call. Closes the evidence loop with the observed execution result; it does not replace pre-execution Permit Verification.

details.description: Optional details about what was executed and the result.

evaluation_id.description: The evaluation_id from the prior evaluate call.

executed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the execution completed.

org_id.description: Organization ID that owns the evaluation.

outcome.description: The actual outcome of the execution.

name: atlasent_record_execution_evaluation
title: AtlaSent — Record Execution Evaluation
